# validate/decode_csv_events_at — events_at must be empty for a csv terminal;
# each row is already an event.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}
    decode:
      - csv:
          header: present
    events_at: response.body.rows

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
requests[0].events_at: error: events_at must be empty for csv decode; each row is an event
